about: Explore specimens for the virtual lab practical (tools v2, docs/tools-v2-anp-lab-practical-brief.md). Each specimen is one lab figure (a station of the named set in data/tools/lab-practical.json) drawn clean: scripts/build-lab-specimens.py paints out every printed label and its leader line and writes figures/specimens/<figure>.webp, cropped to the drawing. Each spot names one asked label of that station; "at" lists the points (figure pixels) where its printed leader lines end on the structure, checked by eye; "does" is the short cause line, checked against the label's "fn". Validated by scripts/lib/anp-tool-checks/lab-specimens.mjs.

specimens.purpose: Name each part of the heart and what it does

spots.label: aorta
spots.does: carries blood from the left ventricle to the body

spots.label: superior-vena-cava
spots.does: returns blood from the upper body

spots.label: inferior-vena-cava
spots.does: returns blood from the lower body

spots.label: pulmonary-trunk
spots.does: carries blood to the lungs

spots.label: right-atrium
spots.does: receives blood from the body

spots.label: left-atrium
spots.does: receives blood from the lungs

spots.label: right-ventricle
spots.does: pumps blood to the lungs

spots.label: left-ventricle
spots.does: pumps blood to the whole body

spots.label: tricuspid-valve
spots.does: stops backflow into the right atrium

spots.label: mitral-bicuspid-valve
spots.does: stops backflow into the left atrium

spots.label: aortic-valve
spots.does: stops backflow from the aorta

spots.label: pulmonary-valve
spots.does: stops backflow from the pulmonary trunk

spots.label: interventricular-septum
spots.does: keeps the two ventricles apart

spots.label: papillary-muscle
spots.does: keeps the chordae tendineae taut

spots.label: chordae-tendineae
spots.does: keep the valve cusps from flipping back

specimens.purpose: Name the brain's lobes and the grooves between them

spots.label: frontal-lobe
spots.does: plans and starts voluntary movement

spots.label: parietal-lobe
spots.does: interprets touch and body position

spots.label: occipital-lobe
spots.does: processes vision

spots.label: temporal-lobe
spots.does: processes hearing and memory

spots.label: central-sulcus
spots.does: separates the frontal and parietal lobes

spots.label: lateral-sulcus
spots.does: the groove above the temporal lobe

spots.label: parieto-occipital-sulcus
spots.does: separates the parietal and occipital lobes

specimens.purpose: Name the bones of the skull and their landmarks

spots.label: frontal-bone
spots.does: forms the forehead

spots.label: parietal-bone
spots.does: forms the top and sides of the brain case

spots.label: temporal-bone
spots.does: forms the lower side of the skull

spots.label: occipital-bone
spots.does: forms the back and base of the skull

spots.label: greater-wing-of-sphenoid
spots.does: the part of the sphenoid seen on the side

spots.label: zygomatic-bone
spots.does: the cheekbone

spots.label: maxilla
spots.does: the upper jaw: holds the upper teeth

spots.label: mandible
spots.does: the lower jaw: the only skull bone that moves

spots.label: nasal-bone
spots.does: forms the bony bridge of the nose

spots.label: coronal-suture
spots.does: joins the frontal and parietal bones

spots.label: squamous-suture
spots.does: joins the temporal and parietal bones

spots.label: lambdoid-suture
spots.does: joins the parietal and occipital bones

spots.label: external-acoustic-meatus
spots.does: the ear canal opening

spots.label: mastoid-process
spots.does: the bump behind the ear where muscles attach

spots.label: styloid-process
spots.does: a thin spike where small muscles attach

spots.label: zygomatic-arch
spots.does: the bony bridge of the cheek, in front of the ear

specimens.purpose: Name each part of a neuron and what it does

spots.label: cell-body
spots.does: holds the nucleus and makes the proteins

spots.label: dendrites
spots.does: carry signals toward the cell body

spots.label: axon
spots.does: carries signals away from the cell body

spots.label: cell-membrane
spots.does: its changes in charge are the signals

spots.label: myelin-sheath
spots.does: insulates the axon so signals travel faster

spots.label: node-of-ranvier
spots.does: a bare gap between myelin segments

spots.label: oligodendrocyte
spots.does: wraps segments of axons in myelin

spots.label: synapse
spots.does: passes the signal to the next cell

specimens.purpose: Name the layers of the skin and what they hold

spots.label: epidermis
spots.does: the surface layer, with no blood vessels

spots.label: dermis
spots.does: tough connective tissue with vessels and nerves

spots.label: hypodermis
spots.does: anchors the skin, stores fat and insulates

spots.label: hair-shaft
spots.does: dead, keratin filled cells above the skin

spots.label: hair-follicle
spots.does: holds the hair root and makes the hair

spots.label: hair-root
spots.does: the part of a hair inside the follicle

spots.label: arrector-pili-muscle
spots.does: pulls the hair upright: a goose bump

spots.label: sebaceous-gland
spots.does: releases oily sebum into the follicle

spots.label: eccrine-sweat-gland
spots.does: makes watery sweat that cools the body

spots.label: pore-of-sweat-gland-duct
spots.does: where sweat leaves the skin

spots.label: adipose-tissue
spots.does: stores fat, insulates and cushions

spots.label: cutaneous-vascular-plexus
spots.does: arteries and veins that feed the dermis

specimens.purpose: Name each part of the kidney and what it does

spots.label: cortex
spots.does: the outer region, just under the capsule

spots.label: medulla
spots.does: the inner region, made of the pyramids

spots.label: pyramid
spots.does: carries forming urine toward its papilla

spots.label: renal-column
spots.does: cortex reaching in between two pyramids

spots.label: papilla
spots.does: drains urine into a minor calyx

spots.label: minor-calyx
spots.does: catches urine from one papilla

spots.label: major-calyx
spots.does: collects urine from minor calyces

spots.label: renal-pelvis
spots.does: funnels urine into the ureter

spots.label: ureter
spots.does: carries urine to the urinary bladder

spots.label: renal-artery
spots.does: brings blood to the kidney

spots.label: renal-vein
spots.does: carries blood out of the kidney

spots.label: capsule
spots.does: a tough layer that covers the kidney
